examples: confusion matrices for time-domain and multi-domain features
argumentation_roles.lesson: A useful figure sequence is baseline representation → failure under perturbation → enriched representation → same split/metric recovery. Keep the noise severity explicit and do not turn one SNR into broad robustness.

argumentation_roles.role: Q2 physics correction and adaptive parameter evidence
argumentation_roles.lesson: Align every correction model on the same held-out-condition folds; training curves support optimization convergence, while leave-condition residual plots support generalization.
Use interaction-effect plots with uncertainty and adjusted covariates; replace a long sequential pairwise-test narrative by corrected all-cell/post-hoc summaries and effect-size intervals.
Ablation ladders are valuable when feature/schema/split stay fixed. Add grouped generalization panels, not only random-row validation.
Convergence plots do not establish feasibility. Pair convergence with a domain-feasibility dashboard and objective-replay table; label every lambda from the exact run config.
